_comment: Billboard placement (game/world/dressing/billboards.gd). Distances in metres. A site is tried at each side offset (beyond the host road's half width) and each shift along the road, in order; the first spot whose post and panel stand clear of every road ribbon, the path kinds listed here, junctions, buildings, water and trees is used, else the board is dropped. Trees: no trunk within trunk_clear_m of the post, and no crown (the band crown_mid +- crown_half_height of the tree's height, crown radius across, as CanopyCover models it) within crown_clear_m of the panel where it overlaps the panel's height. Sidewalks are not listed: a post may stand on one, as sign posts do.
